A-share minute observations
	

Public canonical minute_bars table, published at the dataset owner's request.
Current verified data snapshot: a782bc6163412c33b97324502ebc4fa21f3e7130. It contains 2,322,893,926 rows in 43,352 Parquet files. Read tables/minute_bars/_manifest.json for file hashes, schema and source counts; pin the data commit for reproducibility.
The existing 2018–2025 annual source archives have now been fully converted. The final 869 shards added 49,824,581 rows… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/yuanbosz/a-share-minute-bars.
